Distance Guide Lines (Linked to Steering: Red and Yellow)

Guide line indicating distance from the rear end of the bumper (approx. 50cm)
Estimated course of the vehicle calculated from the steering angle
Lines extending part of the outside of the estimated course when the steering wheel is turned fully to the left or right
